capabilities: Chat with a model from the right sidebar
Import skill profiles and attach text references
Scope note tools to a project folder
Propose Markdown note creates and updates for review
Store and restore transcripts and drafts
extras: Desktop-only and requires Obsidian 1.14.5 or later; no mobile support. Anthropic streaming and tool assembly are fixture-tested, not live-certified. Transcripts, drafts and note recovery files are stored as plaintext in the plugin folder and may be copied by vault sync or backups. The plugin is free; a static link promotes the author's separate paid desktop product and an optional tip jar is exposed through fundingUrl.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to chat with a model about a chosen project folder and have it propose note edits that the user reviews before anything is written.

relations.evidence: The free Obsidian edition of MechApe, by Coda Languez.

summary: Sidebar AI chat companion that connects to Ollama, OpenRouter, Anthropic or OpenAI-compatible endpoints and proposes reviewed Markdown note changes.
